market_pulse: Biotech trials continue to show momentum across various sectors, with significant advancements in infectious disease treatments. This hour's scan focus is on infectious disease trials, highlighting ongoing developments in vaccines and antiviral therapies.

trials.title: A Study to Investigate the Immunogenicity and Safety of mRNA-1345 Vaccine Targeting Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) in High-risk Adults
trials.headline: Moderna's RSV Vaccine Phase 3 Active
trials.brief: Moderna's mRNA-1345 vaccine for RSV is currently in Phase 3 and is actively investigating its immunogenicity and safety in high-risk adults. With recent FDA approvals for mRNA flu vaccines, investor interest in Moderna's pipeline may increase.
